William Oduor is a Staff ML Engineer at Ecomify Solutions, driving scalable NLP pipelines that boosted product search accuracy by 22% across 12 regional markets.  

His work on TensorFlow-based recommendation systems increased cross-sell conversions by 15% while reducing model training time by 30% via distributed computing. He consistently integrates MLflow into production workflows, ensuring experiment reproducibility and stakeholder transparency.  

William’s NLP expertise spans multi-year architecture decisions, including a custom BERT variant that cut customer support query resolution time by 40%. He mentors junior engineers on transformer optimization, balancing technical depth with cross-team collaboration.  

A reliable, data-driven contributor who prioritizes systemic efficiency over short-term wins. His ability to align ML outcomes with business KPIs makes him a strategic asset.
